hyperedges.label: Metrics to Health Score to Alert Pipeline

nodes.label: Sentinel tracing SDK. Importing this module has no side effects.
nodes.norm_label: sentinel tracing sdk. importing this module has no side effects.

nodes.label: D-001 Python 3.12, uv workspace, ruff, pytest
nodes.norm_label: d-001 python 3.12, uv workspace, ruff, pytest
nodes.rationale: One lockfile, fast installs, SDK stays separately installable. Rejected separate repos and pip + requirements files.

nodes.label: D-004 Package name (sentinel-llm)
nodes.rationale: sentinel-sdk is already taken on PyPI by an unrelated project; keeping it would cause an import-name clash.

nodes.label: D-013 UMAP to sklearn HDBSCAN
nodes.rationale: No separate compiled package, no cluster count needed up front, outliers labeled as noise. Rejected k-means.

nodes.label: D-008 One LLM provider behind a wrapper
nodes.norm_label: d-008 one llm provider behind a wrapper
nodes.rationale: One bill and one key in CI; two providers would double setup for no demo value.

nodes.label: D-010 PostgreSQL + pgvector for everything
nodes.rationale: One thing to run, back up and deploy; volumes are small.

nodes.label: D-011 Local embeddings through fastembed
nodes.rationale: Zero API cost and no PyTorch in the worker image, which matters on free-tier instances.

nodes.label: D-012 Drift tests chosen for explainability
nodes.norm_label: d-012 drift tests chosen for explainability
nodes.rationale: Both tests can be explained in an interview in a minute and assume no distribution. Rejected MMD and classifier two-sample tests.

nodes.label: D-016 Response cache makes CI gate cheap
nodes.norm_label: d-016 response cache makes ci gate cheap
nodes.rationale: Unchanged prompts re-run for free and run-to-run noise drops; risk is a stale cache hiding provider-side changes.

nodes.label: Weekly Notes
nodes.rationale: Must be written by the owner; AI-written notes are useless in an interview.

nodes.label: Fault Injection
nodes.rationale: Catching known injected failures is far more convincing than having built a dashboard.

nodes.label: Honesty About Numbers
nodes.rationale: The project's value is that its numbers are real; tuning on reported data is disallowed, so a held-out portion is kept.

nodes.label: Human-Only Work
nodes.rationale: AI-generated human labels would make the judge agreement number meaningless.

nodes.label: Explain-as-You-Build Learn Docs
nodes.rationale: The owner must defend every part in interviews, especially the statistics.

nodes.label: Honesty Note
nodes.rationale: Interviewers will dig in; real explainable numbers beat impressive unexplainable ones.

nodes.label: SDK Guarantees (never raise, never block, bounded memory)
nodes.norm_label: sdk guarantees (never raise, never block, bounded memory)

nodes.label: D-003 SDK built on OpenTelemetry SDK
nodes.norm_label: d-003 sdk built on opentelemetry sdk
nodes.rationale: Context propagation and background batching are solved problems; makes export to any OTel backend nearly free. Rejected hand-rolled spans and raw OTLP in the collector.

nodes.label: run_flags Table
nodes.rationale: The spec has detectors but nowhere to store what they found.

nodes.label: Execution Status vs Correctness
nodes.rationale: A confidently wrong answer is a success with a low quality score; that distinction is the point of the project.

nodes.label: Health Score Missing-Data Rules
nodes.rationale: Missing components are dropped and weights rescaled, never treated as zero; under 20 runs shows not enough data and does not alert.

nodes.label: metric_snapshots Table
nodes.rationale: The spec computes metrics on a schedule but has nowhere to store them; dashboard and alerts read from here.

nodes.label: Ticker Service
nodes.rationale: Metrics and alerts tick every 60 s so time to detect under 10 minutes is reachable; the drift window is configurable so it can be tested without waiting a week.

nodes.label: D-002 Docker Compose, repo outside OneDrive
nodes.norm_label: d-002 docker compose, repo outside onedrive
nodes.rationale: RQ workers need fork() and do not run natively on Windows; OneDrive sync conflicts with .git, .venv, node_modules; Compose is also the final deliverable.

nodes.label: D-009 RQ plus a ticker process
nodes.norm_label: d-009 rq plus a ticker process
nodes.rationale: Far less configuration than Celery for a handful of job types; cron in containers is awkward to test.

nodes.label: Ground-Truth Run Metadata (fault_label)
nodes.rationale: Carries simulator labels for validation only; never fed to detectors or clustering.

nodes.label: D-005 Agent A without framework, Agent B on LangGraph
nodes.norm_label: d-005 agent a without framework, agent b on langgraph
nodes.rationale: Makes the framework-agnostic claim true by exercising both integration paths.

nodes.label: D-006 Fictional product docs for RAG agent
nodes.norm_label: d-006 fictional product docs for rag agent
nodes.rationale: With real docs the model could answer from training data; invented facts make retrieval failures visible.

nodes.label: D-007 Local search tool, not live web search
nodes.norm_label: d-007 local search tool, not live web search
nodes.rationale: Evals need the same question to keep the same right answer; live results change, cost money and need another key.

nodes.label: D-014 Next.js dashboard
nodes.rationale: Frontend is the owner's strongest skill; the trace viewer benefits from custom UI. Streamlit stays as fallback.

nodes.label: D-015 Read keys instead of user accounts
nodes.norm_label: d-015 read keys instead of user accounts
nodes.rationale: Auth beyond API keys is out of scope; a read-only key makes a public demo safe.

nodes.label: D-017 Seed by replaying recorded spans
nodes.norm_label: d-017 seed by replaying recorded spans
nodes.rationale: Replay is free, repeatable and uses real data shapes; fake SQL rows would skip the ingest path.

nodes.label: D-018 Hosting (open)
nodes.rationale: Free tiers change too often to pick 8 weeks ahead.
